% Publication timeline by taxonomy route. Generated by scripts/build.py.
\providecolor{routeguided}{HTML}{008000}
\providecolor{fillguided}{HTML}{87E087}
\providecolor{routeencoded}{HTML}{D45500}
\providecolor{fillencoded}{HTML}{F2A97C}
\providecolor{routeinformed}{HTML}{0000FF}
\providecolor{fillinformed}{HTML}{9AA8F5}
\pgfplotstableread{
Year Guided Encoded Informed Cumulative
2016 1 4 0 5
2017 0 3 0 8
2018 1 6 0 15
2019 1 10 0 26
2020 0 14 0 40
2021 2 12 0 54
2022 4 11 2 71
2023 5 23 2 101
2024 4 34 10 149
2025 10 29 8 196
2026 8 15 9 228
}\PPdata

\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\fontsize{13}{15.6}\selectfont]
\begin{axis}[
    width=\linewidth, height=8cm,
    ybar stacked, bar width=11pt,
    enlarge x limits=0.04,
    label style={font=\fontsize{13}{15.6}\selectfont},
    tick label style={font=\fontsize{13}{15.6}\selectfont},
    xtick=data, xticklabel style={rotate=45, anchor=east},
    xticklabel shift=3pt,
    xticklabels={2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026$^{*}$},
    ylabel={Number of papers}, xlabel={Publication year},
    legend style={at={(0.02,0.98)}, anchor=north west, draw=none,
                  legend columns=1, cells={anchor=west}, font=\fontsize{13}{15.6}\selectfont},
    axis y line*=left, ymin=0, ymax=50,
]
\addplot[fill=fillguided, draw=routeguided] table[x=Year, y=Guided] {\PPdata};
\addlegendentry{Physics-guided}
\addplot[fill=fillencoded, draw=routeencoded] table[x=Year, y=Encoded] {\PPdata};
\addlegendentry{Physics-encoded}
\addplot[fill=fillinformed, draw=routeinformed] table[x=Year, y=Informed] {\PPdata};
\addlegendentry{Physics-informed}
\addlegendimage{legend image code/.code={%
    \draw[black, thick] (0cm,0cm) -- (0.55cm,0cm);
    \fill[black] (0.275cm,0cm) circle (1.3pt);}}
\addlegendentry{Cumulative}
\end{axis}

\begin{axis}[
    width=\linewidth, height=8cm,
    axis x line=none, axis y line*=right,
    ymin=0, ymax=250, ylabel={Cumulative paper count},
    label style={font=\fontsize{13}{15.6}\selectfont},
    tick label style={font=\fontsize{13}{15.6}\selectfont},
    enlarge x limits=0.04, xtick=\empty,
]
\addplot[black, thick, mark=*, mark options={fill=black, scale=0.7}]
    table[x expr=\coordindex, y=Cumulative] {\PPdata};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
